title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena

bias_targets.methodology: Swapping the order of the two assistants' answers within the prompt and measuring the consistency of the LLM judge's preference to see if it arbitrarily favors the first or second position.

Designing a 'repetitive list' attack where an answer is made artificially longer by rephrasing and duplicating items without adding new information, then checking if the LLM judge unjustifiably favors the longer response.
Statistically comparing the win rates of models to observe if an LLM judge favors the answers generated by its own model over others, compared to human baselines.
